authors.bio: David Wood is a consultant to EBU Technology and Innovation, Geneva, Switzerland. He was educated at the University of Southampton, Southampton, U.K., the Popov Institute, Ukraine, and the Harvard Business School, Boston, MA. He worked for the British Broadcasting Company (BBC) and Independent Broadcasting Authority (IBA) in the U.K. before joining the European Broadcasting Union. He led the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) groups that prepared the Recommendations for Digital Television, HDTV, and UHDTV. He has a lifelong interest in media accessibility.
